data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 is compatible with SRC_002: topological superiority (DAG structure) and economic superiority (engineered architectural diversity) are non-exclusive mechanisms by which a large centralized service can achieve strictly greater correlated failure resilience than a decentralized network, provided the large service enforces both internal bulkheading and diverse team practices. Refuted if enforcing a DAG topology in a decentralized network is sufficient to overcome the economic monoculture effect, making the large service's architectural diversity redundant.
